title: Almost-linear approximation of edit distance

result.label: Almost-linear approximation of edit distance
result.statement: For every fixed rational (0,1), gives a randomized (1+ ) approximation to unit-cost edit distance in worst-case expected time N^ 1+o(1) , with success probability at least 2/3. The strings have total length N and polynomially bounded integer symbols. This is an asymptotic guarantee at fixed accuracy.
